title: Vickers Wellington LN660 and Short Stirling EH989
memorial_details: 1. A plain stone pillar with incised, black lettering, situated in a small garden area. 2. To the left of the pillar, a brass plaque mounted on an inclined, polished granite plinth. The dedication is in black script. RAAF, RAF and RNZAF insignias at top of plaque.
inscription: Plinth: IN MEMORY OF / WESTCOTT AIRFIELD / OPENED 09.1942 / CLOSED 03.04.1946 / DEDICATED TO ALL UNITS / AND PERSONEL BASED HERE / AIRFIELDS / OF BRITAIN / Conservation Trust / www.abct.org.uk / UNVEILED BY / KENNETH P. BANNERMAN / DIRECTOR GENERAL ABCT / 28.09.2012 / 70TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE INITIAL ARRIVAL / OF NO. 11 OPERATIONAL TRAINING UNIT // Plaque: IN MEMORIAM / These young airmen lost their lives on 15th March 1944 / in a mid-air collision. / Left column: Wellington X LN 660 KJ-O, / No 11 O T U Westcott / (8 Names) // Right column: Stirling III EH 989 WP-P, / No 90 Squadron / Tuddenham / (7 Names)
community_connection: The memorial is maintained by Wescott Venture Park.
